CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

3. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   C. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
